title: skills: teach the mcp provider's `providerConfig.toolsSnapshot` pin in `skills/objectstack-automation`, the Skills-docs follow-up PR #28515 owes
body:
epic:#27293#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVBKAFk1ntXSjvPt7U

Filing gate: a follow-up owed by landed work. PR #28515 (merged as `76b4ae446`, `Fixes #27401`) added the `mcp` provider's `providerConfig.toolsSnapshot`: a sha256 pin per tool, where a changed definition degrades through `CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_CHANGED`. It documented the pin in `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx` and deliberately left `skills/**` alone, because that surface is governed (Tier H). The dev's report says so: "Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/** not edited (Tier H)". Child of #27293 (E3, author recipes). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Work

Decide whether the integration recipe in `skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md` (the `mcp` recipe, near the `include: ['search_issues']` example at `:82`, read at `origin/main` `76b4ae446`) should teach the pin. If it should, add one short paragraph or bullet covering three things:
- what `toolsSnapshot` pins, and that every pinned name must also be listed in `include`;
- where the digests come from: `computeMcpToolsSnapshot`, or the digest the degraded reason prints;
- what an author sees when a pin no longer matches.

Link to `/docs/automation/connectors` for the rest. The paragraph is paid for under the skills token ratchet. If the skills seat judges the pin too niche for a recipe, record that judgement on this card and close it as `not planned`.

## Business reason

An app-authoring agent reads the skills first. Without the pin in the recipe, the GitHub connector app (and every MCP app after it) is authored with no protection against a server silently changing what a tool means. That is the exposure #27401 was opened to close.

## Reader

The skills seat (`domain:skills`). Triage grades and routes it.

## Dedupe

The 500 most recent issues and PRs (read 2026-11-01T06:21Z), titles grepped for `toolsSnapshot|tool snapshot|tool-snapshot`: 1 hit, PR #28515 itself. Control `skills` on the same set: 35 hits.
